notes: Governed C18 baseline snapshot only; not an OTA player release.
Runtime behavior starts from the 1i image: upstream kiosk.py plus C18 mpv_path wrapper patch.
C18 teardown hardening requests MPV IPC quit, using a fresh IPC connection if needed, before falling back to process signals to avoid panfrost faults on relaunch.
C18 playback hardening verifies the real MPV path after loadfile and playlist-next before trusting preloaded media state.
C18 disables preload_next by default so legacy configs without the field inherit the safe path.
kiosky-player OTA remains frozen until a C18-aware player-runtime contract and hardware gate exist.
